text:
Predicates:
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
BornInCity(x, y) ::: x is born in city y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Writer(x) ::: x is a writer.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
PodcastCreated(x, y) ::: x is created by y.
YearWritten(x, y) ::: x is written in year y.
Premises:
¬Podcast(x) ∧ Novel(x) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornInCity(x, americanCity) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
∀x ((Book(x) ∧ Novel(x)) → (Writer(y, x) → NovelWriter(y))) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(daniShapiro) ∧ Writer(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
WrittenBy(familyHistory, daniShapiro) ∧ Novel(familyHistory) ∧ YearWritten(familyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003 by Dani Shapiro.
PodcastCreated(familySecrets, daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
BornInCity(boston, americanCity) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
¬Novel(familySecrets) ::: Family Secrets is a podcast.
